المعرّف: " + $json.body.production_id + "

description: Receives server.js's notifyN8nProductionEvent() POST once a real production dossier completes, and forwards it to Telegram as a real Arabic message via a plain HTTP Request to Telegram's Bot API — same pattern as 04_Telegram_Notify (ADR-072/073): TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/OPENCLAW_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID read from n8n's own process environment via $env, never embedded in this file or a Telegram credential. ADR-077 (Product Generation Pipeline): this is the pipeline's Telegram Founder Report stage — closes the gap the earlier ADR-06x audit found (this workflow used to only log the event, never actually tell the founder). Not yet imported into the live n8n instance (see n8n_workflows/README.md) — same stop/import/restart step ADR-045/ADR-072 used, requires the founder's explicit go-ahead each time.
